rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose noun for the practice of praying.

example.english: We say a prayer every night before bed.
example.traditional: 我哋每日瞓覺前都會祈禱。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 mui5 jat6 fan3 gaau3 cin4 dou1 wui5 kei4 tou2

rows.note: Use this for a request or petition, especially in formal or legal contexts.

example.english: This is a formal prayer submitted to the court.
example.traditional: 呢份係向法庭提出嘅正式請求。
example.jyutping: ni1 fan6 hai6 hoeng3 faat3 ting4 tai4 ceot1 ge3 zing3 sik1 cing2 kau4

rows.note: Use this for the particular wording or written text of a prayer.

example.english: This prayer text is the one the church requires us to read.
example.traditional: 呢段祈禱文係教會指定要讀嘅。
example.jyutping: ni1 dyun6 kei4 tou2 man4 hai6 gaau3 wui6 zi2 ding6 jiu3 duk6 ge3

rows.note: Use this for the faintest hope or chance, especially in expressions such as 冇一線希望.

example.english: We’ve got not a prayer left.
example.jyutping: mou5 jat1 sin3 hei1 mong6 laa3
